name: TED Search API v3 and official eForms XML notices — bounded non-personal profile
owner: Publications Office of the European Union

access.rate_limit_description: Only explicitly requested publication numbers are downloaded through the official direct XML route. A ResearchRun is capped at four notices and 2 MiB per notice. Search iteration and bulk ingestion are outside this profile.

rights.notes: PRODUCT_ADMITTED applies only to the versioned ted-eforms-non-personal@1.0.0 projection. Raw XML, logos, third-party protected material, natural-person contact data, buyer/winner identity values and unrestricted notice redistribution are excluded. Persisted customer-visible values are deterministic non-personal procedure, geography, code, date and monetary facts with source attribution and modification disclosure.

freshness.expected_cadence: Weekday OJ S publication; direct official XML is retrieved only for explicitly selected publication numbers.
